pages.en:
No. 781
Date 20/12/16

December 20th

Sir,
    Since the return of Messrs Tong Ah Tung 王伯辰
and Tong Kau Ling 楊脫林 to Tientsin it has been ascertained
that they in conjunction with Kai Wei Tsang 愛煥青
and Tung Lai Fong 董蘭芳 of this port planned first of
all to commence a boycott movement against all
French goods. This plan met with no support, the
persons in Shanghai who were willing to aid the
Tientsin people holding that it would produce no
results owing to the scarcity of articles of commerce
of French origin on the market. Then it was proposed
to call a strike of all Chinese in French employment.
Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 being a native of Ningpo, the home
of most of the boys, coolies, cooks, washermen etc of
Shanghai, was to be responsible for carrying out
the scheme, but as it was going to entail considerable
cost and as the expenses therewith were to be met by
the members of the different Chinese trade associations
of Shanghai it was made plain to the promoters that
they were not going to have sufficient financial support
and so the matter dropped. It is stated that Tung Lai
Fong 董蘭芳 was at one time an accountant in the yamen of
the Daotai of Shanghai during the latter period of the
Tsing dynasty and he was on terms of intimacy with
Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 .

                Your Obedient Servant,


        Chief Detective Inspector.

'Captain Superintendent of Police.

第 781 号
日期 16年12月20日

12月20日

先生：
    自王伯辰（Tong Ah Tung）与楊脫林（Tong Kau Ling）返回天津以来，经查证，他们与本埠的爱煥青（Kai Wei Tsang）及董蘭芳（Tung Lai Fong）合谋，首先计划发起一场抵制所有法国货物的运动。该计划未获支持，上海方面愿意协助天津人士者认为，由于市场上原产法国的商品稀缺，此举不会产生任何结果。随后，有人提议号召所有受雇于法国人的华人举行罢工。虞洽卿系宁波人，而上海大多数的仆役、苦力、厨师、洗衣工等均籍隶宁波，故由他负责执行该方案。但由于此举将耗费巨资，且费用需由上海各华商公会成员分担，发起者被告知他们将无法获得足够的财政支持，因此此事遂告中止。据称，董蘭芳（Tung Lai Fong）曾在清朝末期的上海道台衙门担任会计一职，并与虞洽卿交情深厚。

                您顺从的仆人，


        总巡捕长。

致警务处总监上尉
